# openai_project_spend_limit (Resource)

Manages the singleton hard spend limit for an OpenAI project. Threshold amounts are specified in cents. Only one hard spend limit exists per project; multiple resources targeting the same project overwrite one another.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openai_project_spend_limit" "production" {
  project_id       = "proj_abc123"
  threshold_amount = 10000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project.
- `threshold_amount` (Number) The hard spend limit in cents.

### Optional

- `currency` (String) The threshold currency. Currently only `USD` is supported.
- `interval` (String) The evaluation interval. Currently only `month` is supported.

### Read-Only

- `enforcement` (Attributes) The current enforcement state of the hard spend limit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--enforcement))
- `id` (String) The project ID.
- `object` (String) The OpenAI object type.

<a id="nestedatt--enforcement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `enforcement`

Read-Only:

- `status` (String) Whether the hard spend limit is `inactive` or `enforcing`.
